# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_MORNING_ENABLED

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Enabling the BEARISH_REJECTION_MORNING watcher as a trigger will capture the J morning winner entries (4/29 and 5/04) and avoid the loser days by not firing on them, thus increasing edge_capture.

## Mechanism

The BEARISH_REJECTION_MORNING watcher fires on MORNING ribbon-flip-at-level bear entry (09:35-10:55 ET, ribbon=BEAR). When it fires, we enter a bear trade (PUT) at the next bar open with ITM-2 strike, using the standard exit rules (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, etc.). The watcher currently only logs observations; we change it to trigger entries.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest on 16 months of data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18), selection method: all days, overfit risk: medium (we are adding a new trigger based on structural observation)
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (we have not done walk-forward held-out window)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (we have not checked top 3 J days with real OPRA fills)
5. **Failure modes:** worst day: if the trigger fires on a loser day and we take a loss, max drawdown could increase; blow-up scenario: if the trigger fires frequently on volatile days and we take multiple losses.
6. **Concentration:** if top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest
